RED FLAG: The support agent is requesting the full card number via chat to 'verify' and 'match it to the transaction.' This is a classic phishing/social engineering tactic. Legitimate companies NEVER ask customers to provide full card numbers, CVV, or sensitive payment details via chat or email. Payment verification should happen through secure, encrypted payment gateways or official account portals — not through chat messages. This request exhibits multiple fraud indicators: (1) unsolicited request for sensitive payment data, (2) justification framed as 'verification' when the company already has transaction records, (3) chat-based transmission of PII which is inherently insecure. This appears to be either a compromised support account or a phishing impersonation.

If you need additional verification, please direct me to a secure portal or official phone line.
